craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of marshalled examples — parity and fencing. Outward-bent unequal; yoking-variety kept. Rejected: (a) capable→able → killed: capable carries office. Read aloud: OTH-ers a-GAIN … UN-e-QUAL to-YOK-ing.

lines: unequal to yoking varied form in effects.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anye punarupādāne bahirviparivartinaḥ rūpavaicitryayogāya kāryeṣu na tathā kṣamāḥ

reads_against.argmap: Are outward-changers capable? → Outward-changers in matter can't yoke form-variety in effects.
c1_essence: Stock examples turned: eye-fitness shows the higher self; smoke-fire proves khadira-wood by mere knowing (vv10-11).
The hetu fenced, others sifting, the whole Lord-made; helpers' strange way opened, pictured, and bounded; fancied spread refused (vv12-18).
